content:
Anon here, I just want to hold this boy's hand. I MEAN I JUST WANT TO HOLD A BOY'S HAND IN THE HALL, OKAY?  
Not even him specifically, just any boy. Is that so wrong? Apparently yes, because this cage of "normal" will crush me for it.  
Tell me again why everyone cares so much what I do with my hands. Why do they hate us for loving? That's... actually insane.  
Feels surreal hearing people casually insult us like we’re background NPCs in their little life simulation. “We don't exist,” they say, while stepping on us for fun. Cute.  
Any scrap of social life I had? Obliterated the moment I unclench my fingers. Come out of the closet and watch them line us up against the wall of public rejection like it's a spectator sport.  
I just want to be a cute girly boy. I like cute things, pink stuff, soft hands, god forbid. What's so broken about that?  
But nah, I'm the deviant, the plot twist, the punchline they toss around when they need a laugh. Cool. Cool cool cool.  
So yeah, here I am, hands empty and heart tired, begging the void for a single warm palm. Is that a crime or a fantasy? Either way, send help or send hand sanitizer, I guess.
